comment.comment:
Socratically:
The game materials give the coin its own distinct name: DacityCoin.
AudaCity is the company that created and is promoting it. These are already separated in the trailer (“DacityCoin” + “AudaCity”) and in the leak mission.
In both real-world and GTA parody brands, the product name is frequently independent of the company name.
Examples: Bitcoin is not named after Satoshi; Coca-Cola is not named after The Coca-Cola Company in everyday use. Rockstar’s own parodies often follow the same pattern (the product is the memorable unit).
The slogan (“Move to AudaCity”) and the stunt mission promote the company/brand destination, while the coin is the investment vehicle being sold.
This structure does not require the coin’s name or any ticker to incorporate “AudaCity.” It is equally coherent for the coin to remain simply DacityCoin.
No source (trailer, leak dialogue, or wiki) places “AudaCity” inside the coin’s name or treats it as part of the coin’s identifier.
The only confirmed label for the coin itself is DacityCoin.
